decisions.reason: Explains relative sibling specifiers resolve against the entry chunk URL, only the entry was shipped so each sibling 404s while the entry returns 200, and proposes a self-contained single-chunk build with inlineDynamicImports accounting for the full mermaid subgraph.

Pinpoints the second guard comparing original-case LIB_DIR (uppercase E:) against realpath-canonicalized lowercase e: with a case-sensitive startsWith; reconciles Linux (byte-identical), laptop (coincidental case agreement) and production; explicitly rejects 'Windows paths are unreliable' and avoids claiming realpath always lowercases.

Canonicalizes root and candidate via realpathSync, replaces prefix test with path.relative containment rejecting empty, '..', '..'-prefixed and absolute results, symlink escapes resolved before the test, and preserves the JavaScript MIME type.

Explains the same bubbling Ctrl+wheel event reaching both handlers; modal gets exclusive ownership via capture-phase non-passive listener with preventDefault and stopPropagation, which also handles an ancestor capture-phase pane listener; pane additionally ignores events originating inside the overlay.

Planned checks with expected outcomes covering all three incidents: pack-completeness, single-chunk shape and zero-404 import success; mocked case-differing Windows path expects 200 while traversal, absolute and symlink escapes expect 403 plus MIME header assertion; modal Ctrl+wheel zooms with pane font-size unchanged and an outside-the-modal control test.

caps.reason: The fix strengthens containment (canonical containment test keeping symlink checks); no affirmative advice serves outside the resource root.
